title: Automations
subtitle: Let 3Speak do the follow-up work when something happens on your channel or in your wallet: post a snap, a Short, an audio or a video, comment, upvote, reblog, or tell your Discord.
howItWorks: 3Speak looks at your channel every {{minutes}} minutes. Each new post starts the automations that are switched on for it, and everything they post goes out as you, through the posting permission you gave 3Speak. Posts an automation makes never start another one.

gate.unavailable: Automations are not available on this server right now.

list.deleteBody: The automation and its run history are deleted. Posts it already made stay.

video_published.label: I publish a video
video_published.desc: Videos you upload yourself. Imported videos have their own event.

short_published.label: I publish a Short
short_published.desc: Shorts you post, from the uploader, the editor or a clip.

video_imported.label: A video of mine is imported
video_imported.desc: Videos and Shorts that the importer brings in from YouTube, TikTok and the others.

podcast_published.label: I post a podcast episode
podcast_published.desc: Podcast and interview episodes, uploaded or imported from your feed.

audio_published.label: I post any audio
audio_published.desc: Every audio post: podcasts, music, audiobooks and voice messages.

stream_started.label: I go live
stream_started.desc: When the post for your live stream goes out.

tip_received.label: I get a tip
tip_received.desc: A HIVE, HBD or Lightning tip for one of your videos (the memo links it).

boost_received.label: I get a boost
boost_received.desc: A boost on one of your posts, or on your stream.

power_up.label: Power up
power_up.desc: You power up, or someone powers up HIVE to your account.

poll_ended.label: My poll ends
poll_ended.desc: One of your snap polls has ended.

stream_poll_ended.label: A poll in my stream ends
stream_poll_ended.desc: A poll or prediction in one of your streams of the last three days has ended.

someone_posted.label: Someone I pick posts
someone_posted.desc: A post of an account you list below: a video, Short, audio, podcast, snap, stream or text post.

post_snap.label: Post a snap
post_snap.desc: A short text post in the snaps feed, on your profile's Community tab.

post_short.label: Post a Short
post_short.desc: Cuts a clip from the new video and posts it as a Short, about 10 minutes later.

hints.start: Where the clip starts in the video.
hints.vertical: Crops the middle of a wide video to 9:16.

post_audio.label: Post an audio
post_audio.desc: Posts the sound of the new video as an audio post with its cover, about 10 minutes later.

post_video.label: Post a video
post_video.desc: Posts the new audio as a video with its cover as the picture, about 10 minutes later.

post_comment.label: Comment on the post
post_comment.desc: A comment of yours under the post, for links, credits, thanks or results.

reblog.label: Reblog the post
reblog.desc: Puts their post on your blog.

upvote_sender.label: Upvote the sender
upvote_sender.desc: Your upvote on the newest post of whoever tipped, boosted or powered you up (when it still pays out).

send_discord.label: Send to Discord
send_discord.desc: A message to a channel of your Discord server through a webhook. Nobody gets pinged.

hints.webhook: In Discord: channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks, Copy Webhook URL.

if.label: If
if.desc: Takes the Yes path when the condition holds, else the No path.
if.branchesNote: Drag steps into the Yes and No paths on the canvas.

placeholders.title: the post's title
placeholders.author: the account that posted it (you, for your own posts)
placeholders.message: the message that came with it
placeholders.question: the poll's question
placeholders.winner: the answer with the most votes

problems.bad_account_named: "{{name}}" is not a Hive account name.

controlBar.turnOnOffDragAndDrop: Turn moving steps on or off

templates.title: Templates
templates.sub: Start from a template and change it as you like, or start empty.
templates.replaces: Picking a template replaces the steps on the canvas.

snap_video.title: Snap every new video
snap_video.sub: When you publish a video, a snap with its title and link goes out.

short_video.title: A Short from every new video
short_video.sub: When you publish a video, its first 30 seconds become an upright Short.

long_video_short.title: Short for long videos, snap for short ones
long_video_short.sub: Videos over 5 minutes get a Short from second 30, shorter ones a snap.

audio_from_video.title: Audio version of every video
audio_from_video.sub: When you publish a video, its sound is posted as a podcast episode.

imported_discord.title: Tell Discord about imported videos
imported_discord.sub: When the importer brings in a video, your Discord server hears about it.

video_from_podcast.title: Video version of every episode
video_from_podcast.sub: When you post a podcast episode, it is posted as a video with its cover.

podcast_snap.title: Snap every new episode
podcast_snap.sub: When you post a podcast episode, a snap with its link goes out.

discord_live.title: Tell Discord when I go live
discord_live.sub: When you start a stream, your Discord server gets a message.

stream_poll_snap.title: Snap the results of stream polls
stream_poll_snap.sub: When a poll in your stream ends, a snap shows how people voted.

poll_results.title: Reply with the results of my polls
poll_results.sub: When one of your polls ends, a reply under it shows the results.

thank_tips.title: Thank everyone who tips
thank_tips.sub: A thank-you under the video, and an upvote on the tipper's newest post.

thank_boosts.title: Thank everyone who boosts
thank_boosts.sub: A thank-you snap, and an upvote on the booster's newest post.

power_up_snap.title: Share my power ups
power_up_snap.sub: When you power up, a snap says how much. When someone powers you up, they get an upvote.

vote_friends.title: Upvote my friends' new videos
vote_friends.sub: When an account you list publishes a video, it gets your upvote.

reblog_friends.title: Reblog my friends' new videos
reblog_friends.sub: When an account you list publishes a video, it goes on your blog.

blank.title: Start empty
blank.sub: Pick the event and build the steps yourself.

texts.thanksLightning: Thank you for the {amount} HIVE tip! ⚡
texts.thanksStreamBoost: Thank you for the boost on my stream! 🚀 {url}
